pages.title: Read the situation
pages.instruction: Read for the facts and the different priorities
pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: She insisted on paying
paragraphs: Original fictional messages: Guest: “How about dinner on Saturday? Another evening could work too.” Host: “I’ll book after everyone confirms.” Another guest: “I won’t pay a deposit until I’ve read the cancellation conditions.” A later summary wrongly says everyone agreed to pay in advance.

pages.title: What was actually said?
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: How did the dinner planning go? Did everyone agree?
lines.audioText: How did the dinner planning go? Did everyone agree?
lines.translation: Como foi o planejamento do jantar? Todos concordaram?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Not on everything. One person suggested having dinner on Saturday
lines.audioText: Not on everything. One person suggested having dinner on Saturday.
lines.translation: Não em tudo. Uma pessoa sugeriu jantar no sábado

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: And someone promised to book the table?
lines.audioText: And someone promised to book the table?
lines.translation: E alguém prometeu reservar a mesa?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes, the host promised to book after checking the group’s availability
lines.audioText: Yes, the host promised to book after checking the group’s availability.
lines.translation: Sim, quem vai receber prometeu reservar depois de conferir a disponibilidade

pages.title: Correct the stronger claim
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: I heard that everyone agreed to pay in advance
lines.audioText: I heard that everyone agreed to pay in advance.
lines.translation: Ouvi dizer que todos concordaram em pagar adiantado

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: That’s not accurate. One guest refused to pay before seeing the cancellation conditions
lines.audioText: That’s not accurate. One guest refused to pay before seeing the cancellation conditions.
lines.translation: Isso não está correto. Uma pessoa se recusou a pagar antes de ver as condições de cancelamento

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: So suggesting dinner wasn’t the same as committing to the deposit
lines.audioText: So suggesting dinner wasn’t the same as committing to the deposit.
lines.translation: Então sugerir o jantar não foi o mesmo que se comprometer com o depósito

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Exactly. The person who suggested it also said the date was open to discussion
lines.audioText: Exactly. The person who suggested it also said the date was open to discussion.
lines.translation: Exatamente. Quem sugeriu também disse que a data estava aberta a discussão

questions.prompt: Did the reluctant guest reject dinner itself?
questions.answer: No. They refused advance payment before reading the conditions

pages.title: Preserve the intention
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Did anybody admit that the first summary was wrong?
lines.audioText: Did anybody admit that the first summary was wrong?
lines.translation: Alguém reconheceu que o primeiro resumo estava errado?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: The host did. They offered to send a corrected summary to the group
lines.audioText: The host did. They offered to send a corrected summary to the group.
lines.translation: Sim, quem vai receber. Ofereceu-se para enviar um resumo corrigido ao grupo

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That should help. We need to preserve what people actually intended
lines.audioText: That should help. We need to preserve what people actually intended.
lines.translation: Isso deve ajudar. Precisamos preservar o que as pessoas realmente quiseram dizer

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes: a suggestion, a conditional promise and a refusal are three different things
lines.audioText: Yes: a suggestion, a conditional promise and a refusal are three different things.
lines.translation: Sim: uma sugestão, uma promessa condicional e uma recusa são três coisas diferentes

pages.title: A suggestion, not an insistence
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. I want to clarify the dinner message. I suggested Saturday because it seemed convenient; I didn’t insist on that date or promise that everyone would pay in advance. I’m happy to consider another evening. The host said they would book only after checking availability, and one guest still wants to see the cancellation conditions before paying anything. Could you pass that on without making me sound more definite than I was? A useful summary would say what was suggested, what was actually promised and what is still unresolved
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. I want to clarify the dinner message. I suggested Saturday because it seemed convenient; I didn’t insist on that date or promise that everyone would pay in advance. I’m happy to consider another evening. The host said they would book only after checking availability, and one guest still wants to see the cancellation conditions before paying anything. Could you pass that on without making me sound more definite than I was? A useful summary would say what was suggested, what was actually promised and what is still unresolved.
